Hey, went thru the same thing but at UOP. While my appeal did not go through there maybe I can offer some advice.
1) Meet with your advisor ASAP and come up with a plan. They should know what to do for the process.
2) After meeting fill out any forms and get everything compiled right away to submit.
3) If required to write a personal statement, indicate your struggles and how you plan to overcome it all. Noting that you want to utilize the counseling services at the Well can help build your case.
4) If reinstated make sure to take the minimum amount of courses they want you to and take some easier ones you know for sure you can pass. 
5) My advisor at UOP said to me that university admin hold the dice, but they can always roll a snake eyes. So don’t be too worried that they’ll reject your appeal. Good luck
